summary: Coons cosponsored the 2025 Antisemitism Awareness Act mandating the IHRA definition for campus investigations and voted against blocking U.S. arms sales to Israel on multiple occasions, including a 2026 vote on $446.8 million covering D9 bulldozers and 1,000-pound bombs. An April 2024 ceasefire call and a September 2026 E1 settlement sanctions bill coexist with these votes, but permitting continued military transfers to Israel and anchoring campus speech to the IHRA definition mark an Israel-centric posture.
